facets.notes: Claude Code 2.1.267 persists imagePasteIds on each user record. Its message splitting and rendering code advances an image-only counter through top-level message.content blocks and pairs imagePasteIds[counter] with that image block. Text, document and tool_result blocks do not consume an ID. The ID is the number in [Image #N], and is not necessarily the local attachment position. Inspection is limited to this binding; it does not claim a complete writer schema or native image-input fixture. Normalization requires a complete, unique integer ID list and preserves invalid-image slots. The conformance fixtures are synthetic.

Workflow coordinator journal. Untimestamped `started` and `result` records correlate one workflow worker key with its agent id. The journal can be unbalanced and can accumulate prior-attempt starts across a resume; it is lifecycle evidence, not the current roster or a chronology. Observed result payloads are either prose strings or structured objects. Structure-only census of a live organic dataset. Shapes sampled from the first 256 records per type; nested facet shapes from the first 32 records per nested discriminator; observed counts cover the full tree.

Mutable Workflow-run snapshots paired with subagents/workflows/<run>/journal.jsonl and worker transcripts. `workflowProgress` interleaves phase and worker records; worker states are `done`, `error`, `progress`, and `start`, and `cached=true` marks resume reuse. A resume can replace the current roster and task id while the journal retains older starts, so this document is not attempt history. Results are workflow-defined JSON, logs are untimestamped strings, and the full script, scriptPath, args, default model, exact status, metrics, error/result, and current progress all remain evidence. Structure-only census of a live organic dataset. Shapes sampled from the first 4096 records per type; nested facet shapes from the first 32 records per nested discriminator; observed counts cover the full tree.
